mathematics.assertion_tested: Does nonlinear evolution move the linear-vacuum null packet and transport its energy out of a central region?
mathematics.coefficient_domain: float64, pseudospectral spatial derivative, velocity Verlet time evolution
mathematics.conventions: C=a0=Z=I=1, no damping, sources or regulator. Periodic L=512. Phi_tt=D(D Phi-P); P_tt=D Phi-P-sign(P)*b(|P|). b is piecewise-linear inverse of the CFG596 repaired deficit table; its integral is evaluated exactly for this interpolant.

criteria.nonlinear_motion: relative L2 change in gradient >0.01 by t=300
criteria.local_energy_escape: central energy / initial total energy <0.10 at t=300
criteria.linear_control: dropping nonlinear force leaves the null packet stationary to relative gradient change <1e-8

non_claims: Not physical timescales, halo formation or cold mass transport
Periodic energy export from a window is not dissipation
Simultaneous spatial/time refinement does not separate their errors
